verdicts.reason: A is broken. The background pattern is cut into a central strip with empty white on both sides. The white frame sits as a stray box on the right, and the two pink dots float alone inside it. 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS' runs off the white panel onto the pattern. 'THE MINIMALIST' is squeezed into the bottom-left corner beside the opening line, and the date text is tiny. B keeps the original intact but just shrinks it into the middle of the banner: about 60% of the width is dead white bars, nothing is rearranged for the wide format, and the date line is small. It is still the less bad of the two.
